With background SMS fallback for poor networks, it's safety that truly feels human.

records.name: Guru Travels Limited
records.tagline: Explore 5 Iconic Nepal Destinations in One Trip
records.description: Explore Nepal in 13 days! Visit Kathmandu, Lumbini, Chitwan National Park, Pokhara & Namo Buddha. Culture, jungle safari & Himalayan views in one unforgettable trip.

records.name: Shipfolio
records.tagline: A minimal tracker for indie devs. iPhone, web app, Watch
records.description: A minimal project tracker for indie devs. Capture ideas, track progress, and ship with momentum. iOS, web, and Apple Watch, all synced.

records.name: AnyTask
records.tagline: Task management with minimal taps
records.description: AnyTask is built around one idea: the fewer taps between you and your task, the better. No account required, no complexity. Quick capture, an intuitive Sort Mode, natural language scheduling, shared lists with iCloud, and Apple Calendar sync.

records.name: PromptPageAI
records.tagline: AI generated website - 24.90$/mo, domain & hosting included
records.description: PromptPageAI is redefining website creation. No drag-and-drop tools. No technical complexity. Just fill out a simple form, share your needs, and let PromptPageAI handle the rest. For only $17.90/month, you get a fully managed, professional website—complete with hosting, domain, SSL security, mobile responsiveness, and SEO optimization—delivered within 24 hours of completing your configuration. Launching your online presence has never been this fast, effortless, or affordable.

records.name: Survive the Apocalypse
records.tagline: Class tier lists, base building guides
records.description: Class tier lists, base building guides, emerald farming strategies, and the latest patch breakdowns — everything you need to outlast the horde.

records.name: Brat Generator
records.tagline: Brat Generator – Create Free Brat Text, Covers & Memes
records.description: Create your own Charli XCX-inspired brat cover in seconds. Type your text, choose a style, and download free brat visuals using our brat generator

records.name: My Invoice Creator
records.tagline: Create & Download Invoices Free, Fast & Easy!
records.description: Create professional invoices instantly with My Invoice Creator. Use our free online invoice generator with customizable templates, with instant PDF downloads.

records.name: 52weekx
records.tagline: Discover new activities each week
records.description: Plan 52 weeks of real-world adventures with a privacy-first PWA. Discover new activities each week and keep your data on your device.

records.name: Beezi AI
records.tagline: Make AI development structured, secure, and cost-efficient.
records.description: Beezi AI is a platform for orchestration of AI-driven software development. It helps teams structure tickets for better prompts, route tasks to the right models, and track AI usage and costs in real time. With the Analytics Hub, Smart Ticket System, and Model Routing Optimizer, teams reduce rework, control AI spend, and scale development with predictable, measurable outcomes. Beezi supports secure on-prem or private cloud deployment with full control over data and models.

records.name: WePitched
records.tagline: Investment Marketplace
records.description: WePitched is an AI-assisted investment marketplace where real businesses meet capital. Discover clear, structured projects — from cafés and farms to tech and manufacturing — with transparent logic and no paywalls.

records.name: buffalo landscaping
records.tagline: Landscaping
records.description: Affordable Buffalo NY Landscaping experts! Get lush lawns, snow removal & eco-friendly designs from trusted local pros. Call now for a free quote!

records.name: fairClaims by Policygaido
records.tagline: AI that fights your rejected or short-paid insurance claims
records.description: In India, millions of health insurance claims are rejected or underpaid every year most go unchallenged because policyholders don't know what hit them. fairClaims uses AI trained on IRDAI regulations, TPA patterns, and thousands of claim outcomes to instantly analyze your rejection or short-settlement, identify what's recoverable, and generate ready-to-send grievance letters. Free to use. No lawyers. No upfront cost. Results in under 5 minutes.

records.name: Create Pro Presentations FREE with AI
records.tagline: NotebookLM, Gamma, Manus, and Kimi turn research into decks.
records.description: AI can make slides fast, but in 2026, quality is what wins. A great deck needs narrative depth, logic, and reliable data beyond just "looking good." This workshop goes past the "Generate" button. Learn to strategically combine Gamma, Kimi K2.5, Manus, and NotebookLM to transform complex research into high-stakes presentations for investors and clients. Stop just making slides and start telling stories that move your audience and win the room.

records.name: Loview AI
records.tagline: AI, image generator, AI art, text to image, creative tools
records.description: Access all Nano Banana versions in one platform. Generate images, compare outputs, and export high-quality results with free access on Loview AI.

records.name: BAND
records.tagline: Coordinate and govern multi-agent work in a single chat
records.description: BAND helps teams enable and govern interaction across distributed AI agents and human teams. Through a shared interaction layer, it supports real-time multi-peer collaboration with built-in governance, giving organizations a structured way to manage how agents communicate and coordinate. Unlike orchestration tools or agent frameworks, BAND governs the interaction layer itself, reducing fragmentation and making collaboration reliable at scale.

records.name: Spira AI
records.tagline: AI Influencer that always on trend, create & grow your brand
records.description: Built by the teams behind Creatify AI, TikTok, CapCut, Meta, Snap and Midjourney — Spira gives you autonomous AI Influencers that run your social media end-to-end 24/7. They catch trends before they peak, create content in your voice, and publish across TikTok, Instagram, X and more. You stay in control through your preferred chat app — or let them run completely on their own. 10M+ impressions before public launch. Your first AI Influencer is less than 10 minutes away.

records.name: factosecure.com
records.tagline: VAPT, SOC & Cloud Security for India's IT Companies
records.description: Factosecure is a global cyber security company offering VAPT, network security, and cloud security services to businesses worldwide.

records.name: BazaarDiary
records.tagline: AI-Powered Online Trading Journal For Indian Traders.
records.description: BazaarDiary is the premier AI-powered online trading journal built specifically for Indian traders. Auto-sync with Zerodha and Upstox to find your edge.

records.name: Emareach AI
records.tagline: Stop Landing in Spam. Start Getting Replies.
records.description: The cold email platform built to land emails in the inbox. AI-powered outreach with built-in warm-up, deliverability optimization, and multi-account sending — so your cold emails get opened and replied to.

records.name: UK Tax Advisor Course
records.tagline: Best Uk taxation course
records.description: Become a Certified UK Tax Advisor! Learn tax laws, HMRC rules & compliance. Join the top UK Tax Advisor Course and boost your career in taxation today!

records.name: Dev Roast Me
records.tagline: Share what you built and get brutally honest feedback
records.description: A public board where developers submit their portfolios and projects to get roasted by the community. No filters, no sugarcoating.

records.name: Sales-Optimized Support Bot
records.tagline: AI support that turns visitors into buyers
records.description: Most AI support bots answer questions. Ours is built to convert. turns your website traffic into paying customers by guiding users, handling objections, and nudging them toward purchase — automatically. Plug it in. Let it sell.

records.name: TuneJourney.com
records.tagline: AI learns your listening habits and curates your live radio
records.description: TuneJourney is a free, browser-based radio platform powered by AI. While you listen, AI listens with you in real time—detecting music, talk, and ads, learning your taste, and building smart station profiles. It can also auto-skip chatter and ads in live radio so the music keeps flowing. Explore 70,000+ live stations (tunes) across 11,000+ cities (journeys) on an interactive 3D globe. No signup required. Mobile apps coming soon.

records.name: Treasure Escape
records.tagline: Addictive Sliding Puzzle Game to Train Your Brain🧩💡
records.description: Treasure Escape is an addictive sliding puzzle game designed to boost logic and problem-solving skills. Move blocks, solve challenging levels, and unlock hidden treasure paths in a fun adventure setting. This offline puzzle game offers smooth gameplay, relaxing mechanics, and brain-training challenges for all ages. Perfect for fans of logic games, brain games, and strategy puzzles.

records.name: The Room Display
records.tagline: Ipad app for meeting room availability. One-time purchase.
records.description: Turn iPads into conference room displays with real-time availability and instant booking. Works with Google Workspace & Microsoft 365. $99 one-time. No subscription. Ever.

records.name: Text Scroll Loop by Jason Eliphalet
records.tagline: A high-performance, circular typographic display for Framer
records.description: Text Scroll Loop is a bold Framer website centered on seamless, continuous typography. It features a smooth infinite scrolling text animation that creates a dynamic visual rhythm, turning simple words into engaging motion. Designed for impact, it’s ideal for hero sections, brand messaging, and modern interfaces that aim to capture attention through clean design and fluid animation.

records.name: Logo Master: Guess the Logo
records.tagline: Guess the logos. Test your brain.
records.description: Can you name the world's most iconic brands, flags, and logos? Logo Master is an addictive quiz game where you identify logos by spelling out their names from scrambled letters. With 14 themes ranging from classic brands to football clubs, country flags to anime — there are over 1,400 logos to discover. Earn coins, unlock new levels, and prove you're the ultimate logo expert.
